text:
During a thoughtful evening, many thanks for your careful letter; we looked into it and I want to say upfront that your concern was handled with care. You explained that your trip was disrupted when your companion animal travel arrangements and the departure flow did not go as expected, and I understand why that felt upsetting and tiring.

From a safety review point of view, the main issue was not the presence of the animal, but the way the handoff and communication were managed around the departure. That is on us to review closely. Our crews and ground staff are expected to keep companion animal travelers informed, calm, and supported, and when that standard is not met, we treat it seriously. <<FACT F109>> We also check whether the booking notes, cabin handling steps, and station coordination were followed in the right order so that the same kind of confusion does not repeat.

What we are doing now is reinforcing the instructions already shared with the crew, so the team has a clearer playbook when a delay affects a traveler with a companion animal. We are also reminding staff to give simple updates in plain language, confirm the animal's needs early, and avoid leaving anyone guessing. That kind of steady communication matters a lot, especially when a traveler is already stressed.

If there was extra inconvenience in the terminal, I am sorry for that too. Even when the flight side is under pressure, we still expect respectful service and practical support, and your note helps us see where the process slipped. We appreciate you taking the trouble to write in, because that is how we keep the system safer and kinder for everyone traveling with a companion animal.

We hope you will travel with Aurelia Skyways again and give us a chance to show a smoother experience next time.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
